name: Santa Monica Place
description: Santa Monica Place is a premier three-level open-air shopping destination located steps from the Pacific Ocean and world-famous Santa Monica Pier, featuring luxury retailers, celebrated restaurants, and stunning ocean views. Redesigned by renowned architect Jon Jerde, this sophisticated shopping center blends Southern California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle with upscale shopping and dining experiences. The rooftop dining deck offers panoramic ocean vistas while shoppers enjoy an exceptional mix of fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands.
demographics: Affluent coastal demographic with high household incomes, mix of local residents and international tourists, strong appeal to millennials and fashion-conscious shoppers seeking premium brands and experiences
summary: An upscale open-air shopping destination in Santa Monica featuring luxury retailers, acclaimed dining, and breathtaking ocean views near the iconic Santa Monica Pier.
